# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header
- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by "Activities" in top-left corner)
- **Application Title Bar**: "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 19:39" displayed in the top-center of the window
- **System Tray Icons**: Located in the top-right corner, including:
  - Sound/volume control
  - Power button
  - Network/Bluetooth indicator
  - Notification bell icon

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help
- **Active Menu**: "Slide" menu is open, displaying a dropdown list of options

## Slide Navigation Panel
- **Location**: Left side of the interface
- **Content**: Vertical list of slide thumbnails
- **Slide Count**: 10 slides visible, with "Slide 1 of 18" displayed at the bottom
- **Slide Titles**:
  1. "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING"
  2. "AGENDA"
  3. "BACKGROUND"
  4. "WHY STRATEGIC PLANNING?"
  5. "HOW DID WE GET HERE?"
  6. "WHAT DO WE NEED FROM YOU?"
  7. "DISCUSSING THE STRATEGIC PLAN"
  8. "STRATEGIC DIRECTIONS"
  9. "MEMBERSHIP"
  10. (Slide 10 thumbnail visible, but title not fully readable)
- **Slide Indicators**: Each thumbnail has a small "content" label at the bottom

## Main Slide Editing Area
- **Current Slide**: Slide 1, titled "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING"
- **Slide Content**:
  - Main Title: "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING" in large, bold, black font
  - Subtitle: "SEPTEMBER 29 and OCTOBER 1, 2015" in smaller black font
  - Footer: "asis&t" logo in red, with "Association for Information Science and Technology" in smaller text below
- **Slide Layout**: Title slide with minimal content

## Toolbars
- **Top Toolbar**: Contains icons for common functions including:
  - File operations
  - Slide management
  - Text formatting
  - Drawing tools
  - Object insertion
  - Slide show controls
- **Secondary Toolbar**: Located below the main toolbar, with additional icons for:
  - Text boxes
  - Shapes
  - Tables
  - Charts
  - Images
  - Media
  - Special characters
  - Drawing tools

## Properties Panel
- **Location**: Right side of the interface
- **Panel Sections**:
  - **Slide Properties**:
    - Format: "Widescreen"
    - Orientation: "Landscape"
    - Background: "None"
    - Master Slide: "Title Slide"
    - Master Background: Checked
    - Master Objects: Checked
  - **Layouts**:
    - Grid of layout thumbnails
    - Currently selected layout is highlighted with a red border
    - Layouts include various combinations of title and content areas

## Slide Menu Dropdown
- **Open Menu**: "Slide" menu is expanded
- **Menu Options**:
  - New Slide
  - Duplicate Slide
  - Insert Slide from File...
  - Layout
  - Delete Slide
  - Save Background Image...
  - Set Background Image...
  - Slide Properties...
  - Change Slide Master...
  - New Master
  - Delete Master
  - Master Background
  - Master Objects
  - Master Elements...
  - Show Slide
  - Hide Slide
  - Rename Slide...
  - Jump to Last Edited Slide (Shift+Alt+F5)
  - Move
  - Navigate
  - Summary Slide
  - Expand Slide
  - Slide Transition

## Status Bar
- **Location**: Bottom of the window
- **Information Displayed**:
  - "Slide 1 of 18"
  - Zoom level: "92%"
  - View mode: "Title Slide"
  - Coordinates: "-0.52 / -1.87"
  - Object dimensions: "0.00 x 0.00"
  - Language: "English (USA)"

## Sidebar Icons
- **Location**: Left side of the screen, below the Activities button
- **Icons**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
